text: {"status":"ANSWERED","claims":[{"text":"Harbourline information may be shared with vendors under conditions set by this policy.","evidence_id":"E4","quote":"This policy sets the conditions under which Harbourline information may be shared with third parties such as vendors, partners and service providers."},{"text":"A vendor must pass a Vendor Security Assessment before it receives any Confidential or Restricted information.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"A third party must pass a Vendor Security Assessment before it receives any Confidential or Restricted information."},{"text":"Sharing Confidential information with a third party requires approval from the data owner after the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"Sharing Confidential information, including confidential customer information, with a third party requires approval from the data owner after the Vendor Security Assessment has been passed."},{"text":"Every approved sharing arrangement must be recorded in the Third-Party Data Register.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"Every approved sharing arrangement must be recorded in the Third-Party Data Register, including the data categories shared, the approvers and the review date."},{"text":"Information must be transferred using the company managed file transfer service or another approved secure transfer method.","evidence_id":"E5","quote":"Information must be transferred using the company managed file transfer service or another approved secure transfer method."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":[],"conflict_note":""}
